_comment: Main Lucky Block Cobblemon settings. New configs live in config/luckyblockcobblemon/. These are the global public defaults, not a Kanto/server-safe preset.
_note: enablePocketRecipe: enables/disables the recipe for luck_block_pocket.
enableVanillaRecipe: enables/disables the recipe for luck_block_vanilla.
enablePocketWorldgen: enables/disables natural generation of themed Lucky Blocks in new chunks.
enableStructureWorldgen: enables/disables natural structure generation from this mod in new chunks.
enableStructureEvents: allows structure events inside Lucky Block pools. If false, structure events will not run even if they exist in a pool.
strictConfigEvents: if true, Lucky Blocks only execute valid events from the loaded config and never use hidden fallback events.
breakCreativeDefaultLuckyBlock: controls whether the default Lucky Block triggers in Creative Mode.
breakCreativeThemedLuckyBlocks: controls whether themed Lucky Blocks trigger in Creative Mode.
breakCreativeLegendaryLuckyBlock: controls whether the Legendary Lucky Block triggers in Creative Mode.
Recipe changes require /reload or a server restart. Worldgen changes require a server restart and only affect new chunks.
